newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela seeks to double tax base.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela seeks to double tax base.

text.p: Venezuela is seeking to more than double its income tax base to 550,000 people by lowering the tax exemption rate, Venezuelan tax superintendency Seniat president Edgar Paredes Pisani said.
The proposed changes, due to be discussed with IMF officials next week, will lower income tax exemptions to those with annual incomes of 2.7 million bolivars ($5,700) per year or less.
Current exemptions apply to those with incomes of 4.5 million bolivars ($8,617 or less), Paredes said, with some 250,000 people -- or 6.6 percent of total families -- paying tax.

Paredes Pisani said he hoped the change -- when combined with other measures that would tax some of the nearly 40 percent of the workforce employed in the informal economy -- would boost tax collection by two percentage points of gorss domestic product to around five percent.
